name: Trade Quarter
summary: Trade Quarter draws the Undercity’s commerce and civic life beneath the Ruins of Lordaeron. Its bank, auction house, and other services serve the Forsaken capital, while corridors link it to the surrounding districts.

sections.title: Heart of the Crypts
sections.body: You step from the lifts beneath the Ruins of Lordaeron into the Trade Quarter’s broad, circular halls. Canals of noxious runoff circle the central platform, crossed by bridges. The city’s coffers and bank rest there, while vendors, guild registrars, and auctioneers work along the terraces. At the inn, wooden caskets replace soft beds. Stone archways lead into the other districts, drawing the Undercity’s business through its center.

faq.q: Where is the Trade Quarter located?
faq.answer: The Trade Quarter lies at the center of the Undercity. Lifts beneath the Ruins of Lordaeron carry you from the surface into its upper ring.

faq.q: What services are found in the Trade Quarter?
faq.answer: The Trade Quarter holds the Undercity’s central bank, an auction house along the outer ring, and the primary inn. You can also find a bat handler for air travel, guild registrars, and trade trainers, including the city’s cooking mentor.

faq.q: Why are there coffins in the inn?
faq.answer: The Forsaken need no true sleep, and many keep habits suited to their undead condition. The inn offers plain, unlined wooden caskets for comfort, though they can unsettle living visitors.

faq.q: Who is the vendor lurking beneath the bridges?
faq.answer: Jeremiah Payson sells live pet cockroaches beneath one of the central bridges leading to the bank. Other merchants above sell weapons and trade goods.

angles.text: As an Undead, you see the Forsaken restore civilized order in the Trade Quarter. Their underground market helps fund their survival.
As an Orc, Tauren, or Troll emissary arriving in Tirisfal Glades, you find a foreign, shadowy market at the heart of your northern allies’ capital.
